abstract: Mediastinal teratoma with malignant transformation (TMT) is a very rare condition. A 44-year-old man presented with a large cystic mass of the anterior mediastinum. The tumor was surgically removed. The cystic mass was well demarcated, with an irregularly thickened wall. Histologically, the cystic wall was mainly lined by non-ciliated columnar epithelium and focally by squamous epithelium. A nodular part of the cystic wall revealed well-differentiated adenocarcinoma composed of tubulopapillary structures. Deep in the nodular tissue, neoplastic glands merged into undifferentiated sarcomatous cells. Immunohistochemically, CK7, CK19, and smad-4 were strongly and diffusely positive in adenocarcinoma. CD10 was focally positive on the luminal surface of the glands, and MUC5AC was also focally positive. TTF-1, cdx-2, and CK20 were negative in the adenocarinoma. Sarcomatous area showed diffuse strong positivity for vimentin, but was negative for the aforementioned epithelial markers. About 10 months postoperatively, a left pleural effusion had developed with multiple pleural nodules on computed tomography scan of the chest. The cytologic diagnosis from pleural fluid was metastatic adenocarcinoma. To our knowledge, in the English literature, this is the first case of adenocarcinoma with sarcomatous transformation that has developed in a mature cystic teratoma of the mediastinum and shows pleural metastasis.
abstract_ja: 縦隔奇形腫の悪性転化（TMT）は非常にまれな病態である。44歳男性が前縦隔の大きな嚢胞性腫瘤で受診した。腫瘍は外科的に切除された。嚢胞性腫瘤は境界明瞭で、壁は不規則に肥厚していた。組織学的には、嚢胞壁は主に非線毛性円柱上皮で覆われ、部分的に扁平上皮で覆われていた。壁の結節部分には、管状乳頭状構造からなる高分化型腺癌が認められた。結節の深部では、腫瘍性の腺管が未分化な肉腫様細胞へと移行していた。免疫組織化学的に、腺癌ではCK7、CK19、smad-4が強く広範に陽性であった。CD10は腺管内腔面で局所的に陽性、MUC5ACも局所的に陽性であった。腺癌ではTTF-1、cdx-2、CK20は陰性であった。肉腫様部分はビメンチンが広範に強陽性であったが、上記の上皮マーカーは陰性であった。術後約10か月で、胸部CTにて左胸水の貯留と多発性胸膜結節が認められた。胸水の細胞診では転移性腺癌と診断された。英文文献の知る限り、縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生し、胸膜転移を示す肉腫様転化を伴う腺癌の症例はこれが初めてである。
